rows.note: Use 服務 as the all-purpose noun for a business or technical service that is provided.

example.english: Many companies now value customer service.
example.traditional: 依家好多公司都重視客戶服務。
example.jyutping: ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 zung6 si6 haak3 wu6 fuk6 mou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for providing a service to customers or the public.

example.english: We will wholeheartedly service the public.
example.traditional: 我哋會全心全意服務市民。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 cyun4 sam1 cyun4 ji3 fuk6 mou6 si5 man4

rows.note: Use this for routine servicing and preventative maintenance, especially of a car or appliance.

example.english: We service this car every six months.
example.traditional: 我哋每半年都會保養架車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 bun3 nin4 dou1 wui5 bou2 joeng5 gaa3 ce1

rows.note: Use this when servicing a machine involves repairing or maintaining faulty equipment.

example.english: The air conditioner is broken, so we need someone to service it.
example.traditional: 部冷氣壞咗，我哋要搵人維修。
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 jan4 wai4 sau1

rows.note: Use 發球 specifically for a serve that starts play in tennis, volleyball, and similar sports.

example.english: Their service hit the net, so the opponent scored right away.
example.traditional: 佢發球落網，對手即刻得分。
example.jyutping: keoi5 faat3 kau4 lok6 mong5 deoi3 sau2 zik1 hak1 dak1 fan1

rows.note: Use 軍隊 when service means the armed forces or the military as an institution.

example.english: Their older brother is still in the military service.
example.traditional: 佢哥哥而家仲喺軍隊入面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go1 go1 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai2 gwan1 deoi6 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use 兵役 for the duty or period of serving in the military rather than for the military itself.

example.english: They have to do military service next year.
example.jyutping: keoi5 haa6 nin4 jiu3 fuk6 bing1 jik6
